title: Reionization photon budget: source shortfall versus assumption shortfall
short_title: A photon-budget mismatch has two explanations
tts_instructions: Measured scientific-conference narration in Alloy. Calm, precise, and authoritative. Motivate the first four sentences warmly and conditionally, with no result cadence. Give the redshift-sweep discriminant the strongest intellectual emphasis. Do not imply a value, sign, crossing, or trend has been revealed.

sentences.text: At each redshift, a photon budget can look open because galaxies leak too little ionizing light, or because model assumptions carry the mismatch.

params.subtitle: WHY THE BUDGET NEEDS A DISCRIMINANT
params.left_body: galaxies leak too little ionizing radiation
params.right_body: transported proxies or frozen priors create the mismatch
params.question: HOW DO WE TELL SOURCES FROM ASSUMPTIONS?

sentences.text: If galaxies were genuinely leaking too little ionizing radiation, that would limit how they could maintain reionization.

params.subtitle: THE PHYSICAL POSSIBILITY
params.left_body: galaxies leak too little ionizing radiation
params.right_body: transported proxies or frozen priors create the mismatch
params.question: HOW DO WE TELL SOURCES FROM ASSUMPTIONS?

sentences.text: But an apparent shortfall could instead be a fact about low-redshift proxy transport or another frozen assumption, not about the galaxies.

sentences.text: How do we tell a source shortfall from an assumption shortfall?

params.left_body: galaxies leak too little ionizing radiation

sentences.text: One redshift cannot settle that question, because required and inferred escape fractions each carry an uncertainty structure that can overlap or separate.

params.heading: WHY ONE SLICE CANNOT SETTLE IT
params.bottom: A SINGLE COMPARISON CANNOT IDENTIFY THE FAILURE MODE

sentences.text: The method must ask how the full envelopes behave across redshift and how that comparison changes when the assumptions are challenged.

params.heading: THE AMBIGUITY LIVES ACROSS A SWEEP
params.bottom: THE DISCRIMINANT IS THE RESPONSE OF THE WHOLE SWEEP

sentences.text: The discriminating move is a redshift sweep that computes the required and proxy-inferred escape-fraction envelopes under the same declared prior draws.

params.heading: THE DISCRIMINANT: SWEEP BOTH ENVELOPES
params.outcome: COMPARE THE FULL ENVELOPES · NO ORDER OR CROSSING IS REPORTED

sentences.text: At every grid position, the required side propagates recombination, ionizing-efficiency, clumping, and source-density assumptions as one auditable calculation.

params.heading: PROPAGATE THE REQUIRED SIDE
params.outcome: SAME GRID · SAME DECLARED PRIORS · VALUES WITHHELD

sentences.text: The inferred side transports both proxy calibrations through the identical sweep so calibration choice and calibration transport remain separable questions.

params.heading: KEEP CHOICE SEPARATE FROM TRANSPORT
params.outcome: PROXY CHOICE TESTS ONE BIAS · TRANSPORT TESTS ANOTHER

sentences.text: Then the sweep is rerun under a challenged source-density prior, while a separate boundary keeps proxy evolution outside the modeled envelope.

params.heading: CHALLENGE THE PRIOR WITHOUT MOVING THE BOUNDARY

sentences.text: Only that paired response can distinguish a mismatch stable within the declared model from one that depends on an untested transport assumption.

params.heading: THE RESPONSE OF THE SWEEP IS THE TEST
params.outcome: GALAXY LIMIT OR ASSUMPTION LIMIT? · OUTCOME WITHHELD

sentences.text: The source ledger is a sequence of model inputs, redshift positions, prior draws, and scenario reruns, with the scientific outputs omitted here.
sentences.display_citation: Archived sweep ledger · outputs not displayed

params.heading: SOURCE ACCOUNTING WITHOUT RESULT VALUES
params.banner: PIPELINE UNITS ONLY · NO SCIENCE OUTPUT

sentences.text: Because no sibling source freeze exists, this canary carries the pipeline stages but drops every result count, threshold, and curve value.

params.heading: DROP UNSAFE VALUES, KEEP THE METHOD
params.banner: NO SOURCE FREEZE · NO RESULT CARD

sentences.text: The estimator is the required escape fraction minus the proxy-inferred escape fraction at each redshift, shown symbolically without a value or sign.

params.heading: BUILD THE ESTIMATOR WITHOUT REVEALING IT

sentences.text: Its uncertainty is the propagated systematic envelope from matched prior draws, not a measurement error and not a probability about the sky.
The dual-proxy arms test calibration choice, while the source-density corner tests whether a coupled prior drives the comparison.
Proxy-transport evolution is kept as an external challenge, because changing both inference arms together cannot be detected by agreement between them.

params.heading: A CONTROL MUST MATCH THE FAILURE MODE

sentences.text: We tied our own hands by freezing the anchors, grid, estimator, and systematic corners before inspecting any crossing or trend.
sentences.display_citation: Archived budget formalism and sweep design

params.bottom: THE MODEL CANNOT MOVE AFTER THE SWEEP IS SEEN

sentences.text: The gates are scientific discipline: one grid position cannot be promoted after the fact, and an external systematic cannot be smuggled into the envelope.
What is known is the formalism and test design; curve values, crossings, signs, and any statement about real galaxies remain outside this canary.
Ask the opening question again: would a mismatch belong to the galaxies, or to the assumptions transported into the budget?

params.heading: GALAXIES OR ASSUMPTIONS?
params.banner: METHOD DESIGNED · VALUE AND SIGN WITHHELD

sentences.text: Now we have a test that can separate those explanations without asserting which one the unfrozen evidence supports.

params.heading: THE METHOD EARNS THE ANSWER
params.banner: NO RESULT CLAIM IN THIS CANARY
